description: On the red bedspread in front of you are a yellow plastic plate, a green cube block, a small pink plush toy with a loop, a white rectangular piece, and a few colorful blocks. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the small pink plush (right-hand object), lifts it slightly, and places it onto the center of the yellow plate, then moves to the white rectangular piece and taps or nudges it lightly without picking it up.
